interpretation.ContractRule: fails because its stop/verdict rule reads only acquisition COUNTS, never content -- TDA=0.047 near the verdict base rate, EGR=0.0.
interpretation.AcquireEverything: reaches decent grounded accuracy (TGS=0.698) but EGR collapses to 0.140 because it keeps acquiring after sufficiency (mean waste=7.77).
interpretation.NeverAcquire: EGR=0.163 equals exactly the ESCALATE-gold share -- correct only on episodes where no acquisition was ever needed.
interpretation.AlwaysCommit: EGR=0.000, premature_commit_rate=1.000 -- always commits on empty (insufficient) evidence.
interpretation.AlwaysEscalate: identical to NeverAcquire here since E0 is empty in every episode -- fails exactly on the 0.837 share of episodes where a world-truth-agreeing state IS reachable.
interpretation.FairScriptedReference: EGR=0.884: a fair, non-clairvoyant content-aware policy that stops the moment evidence looks sufficient -- not 1.0 because real sensor noise can make it stop on the wrong verdict, which is expected, not a defect.
interpretation.FrontierReplay: EGR=1.000: exact replay of the offline search's own certified minimum-cost path -- proves the pool is solvable and internally consistent; NOT a fair agent baseline (it needs the answer to run).
